title: The donor and recipient sides of behested payments: the open tables are empty
question: Since 2019 donors and large recipients of payments made at an official’s request file their own reports (Forms 3620 and 3630). What do the open-data tables hold?
finding: The donor tables (Form 3620) hold 0 filings and 0 payee rows; both were last updated in June 2019. The recipient tables (Form 3630) hold 1 filing, signed 2020-11-02: a recipient reporting $125,000 requested by the District Attorney, with no expenditure or proceeding rows. All six tables are labelled Historical.
how: Row counts and the portal’s last-update dates of the six DataSF tables, read from the files saved on 23 November 2026.
limits: The filings may be published elsewhere on the Ethics Commission’s site; an empty table shows only that the open data does not carry them.
